claims: Chivas defeated Atlas 1-0 in the Clásico Tapatío friendly match.
The Clásico Tapatío friendly match was held on Sunday, March 29, 2026.
The Clásico Tapatío friendly match was held at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles.
Ángel Sepúlveda scored the only goal of the Clásico Tapatío friendly match.
Ángel Sepúlveda scored the goal with a header in the 56th minute.
The goal followed a cross from Efraín Álvarez
